description: Trigger: import/mbox.rs import_messages() calls connect_nntp() on every iteration of the article loop (line 245). Bad behavior: for large mbox files (e.g. a 100k-article archive) this creates 100,000 TCP connections sequentially. Each connection incurs TCP handshake overhead plus the NNTP greeting round-trip. Import is dramatically slower than necessary and creates load on the transit daemon's accept loop. Connection exhaustion is possible on OS file-descriptor-limited systems.
title: mbox import opens a new TCP connection per article instead of reusing one
